EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents.

itemList.itemName: Running of Guest House Mess and Canteen Facility at Karnatak University, Dharwad, in the well equipped Guest House premises (Area 72.95 Sq. Ft./Sq. M.) for a period of 02 years. Minimum monthly rent Rs.6,000/-, with bidders required to quote higher than the minimum rent. Rent shall be enhanced by 10 percent after completion of the first year, subject to satisfactory performance and tender conditions.
